data.name: Uthaya
data.gender_notes: Uthaya is used as a unisex name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Uthaya is recorded with the meaning “Born”. Uthaya is a Hindu name meaning “Born”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses. Note: this meaning has not been independently verified against a classical lexicon or primary source and is flagged for source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Uthaya expresses “Born”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.

in_sanskrit.name: Utthaya
in_sanskrit.meaning: the one who arises, rises, or has arisen
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who has risen above the mundane, world, who has risen to enlightenment, or who has arisen to power and dominion.

in_hindi.name: उठाय
in_hindi.long_meaning: He who rises, arises, or has arisen.

in_tamil.name: உதய
in_tamil.meaning: உடன் வரும், உடன் உள்ள, ஆத்மா, இரவில் மகாவர்
in_tamil.long_meaning: He who is present, exists, is a lord, or is a great master.

in_telugu.name: ఉదేయ
in_telugu.long_meaning: He who rises, arises, or is the Lord.

in_marathi.name: Uthaya
in_marathi.long_meaning: Uthaya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who is born or comes to life

in_bengali.name: Uthaya
in_bengali.long_meaning: Uthaya একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who is born or comes to life
